meta: Part 4 of "AI and your job". Last time we named the skills that keep their value; now it's time to show employers. Many companies use software to filter resumes. Use AI to check yours and practice interviews.
prompt: Play the interviewer for this role and ask me one question at a time.

muc.title: You have the skills, now apply
muc.text: Last time, we found the skills that keep their value. Now it's time to show them to employers.

muc.title: The other side uses AI too
muc.text: Employers use software more and more, including AI, to filter applications. A resume that doesn't match the job description may be rejected before anyone reads it.

muc.title: Compare your resume to the job description
muc.text: Paste the job description and your resume, and ask AI: what's my resume missing for this role? It shows what matches and what isn't mentioned.

muc.title: Only write what's true
muc.text: But only rewrite what you've really done, more clearly. Don't let AI add experience you don't have.

muc.title: Practice interviews with AI
muc.text: Then ask AI to play the interviewer for that exact role. It asks one question at a time, you answer, and it gives feedback. A few rounds and you'll feel much more confident.

muc.title: Two things to try
muc.text: Remove sensitive personal details from your resume, paste it with the job description, and ask "what's missing?". Then ask AI to give you a mock interview, one question at a time.

muc.title: Last part: a 90-day plan
muc.text: Finally, you need a plan so you don't fall behind. The last part puts everything into a 90-day roadmap.
